name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Warlord MK-VII Tactical Command B
description:
The Warlord MK-VII is Arcturus Defense Solutions' flagship battlefield command interface, engineered for senior field officers and special operations commanders operating in high-intensity contested environments. The unit processes eight simultaneous tactical data streams — including LIDAR terrain mapping, squad biometric telemetry, enemy contact grids, drone swarm positional arrays, artillery fire solutions, encrypted comms, electronic warfare threat vectors, and logistics pipelines — with a latency of under 1.2 milliseconds per stream. Its triple-redundant Faraday mesh architecture, woven directly into a titanium-ceramic cranial housing, provides hardening against EMP bursts up to Class-9 military grade. Quantum-encrypted comms operate on a rotating 4096-qubit key exchange cycle, making interception computationally infeasible within the duration of any known engagement. Direct Automaton Control Interface (DACI) protocols allow the operator to simultaneously command up to twelve Iowan Behemoth-class autonomous combat machines and forty-eight light drone units through neural gesture language, bypassing all manual input latency.

The Warlord MK-VII is the cyberware equivalent of a general's war room compressed into a single skull, and in GLMZ's sprawling contested zones it has become the defining mark of a true theater commander. Officers who receive the implant are colloquially said to have 'taken the throne' — a reference to the overwhelming flood of information dominance the unit confers, and the near-godlike situational awareness it grants over a battlefield. Within Arcturus's own corporate culture, MK-VII recipients are inducted into an informal brotherhood called the Warlord Circle, whose members share a private encrypted channel accessible only through the implant's quantum comm stack. Civilian governments deeply distrust the device; several independent city-states have classified its possession as an act of preparation for armed insurrection.
legality: Military-Only — Possession by non-credentialed civilians constitutes a Class-A weapons felony in 34 jurisdictions
installation_requirements: Full cranial surgical suite; minimum 72-hour inpatient neural calibration; requires pre-existing Tier 3+ neural mesh substrate; board-certified military cybernetic surgeon with Arcturus clearance level Omega
rejection_risk: Moderate-High (22%) — Neural inflammation events reported in candidates lacking prior BCI conditioning; mandatory 6-month pre-conditioning protocol recommended
maintenance: Quarterly Arcturus-certified firmware synchronization; annual hardware inspection of Faraday mesh integrity; quantum key stack replacement every 18 months; emergency field reset via encoded biometric passphrase

side_effects: Persistent tactical overlay bleed into civilian vision — operators frequently perceive threat vectors and target brackets overlaid on non-combat environments, causing severe social disorientation

Hierarchical cognition compression: prolonged use rewires decision-making to prioritize strategic abstraction over individual empathy, reported as 'command detachment syndrome' in psychiatric literature
Sleep-state command loops — operators frequently issue coherent tactical orders while fully unconscious, occasionally activating linked drone units
Chronic mild tinnitus from the quantum comm stack's carrier signal, rated at 14-18 dB subjective perception
cultural_context: In GLMZ's military culture, the Warlord MK-VII occupies a near-mythological status. Veterans who have served under a MK-VII commander describe the experience as fighting alongside something between a human and a god of war — every decision arriving with preternatural precision, every resource allocated with inhuman efficiency. The implant has spawned its own slang lexicon across the contested zones: to be 'in the crown's light' means to be under a MK-VII commander's protection, while 'going dark on the throne' describes the feared psychological breakdown state where an operator becomes so immersed in battlefield data that they lose contact with their own humanity entirely.
known_users: Arcturus Defense Solutions Special Operations Command
Several undisclosed private military corporations operating in the Outer Sprawl
story_hooks: A decommissioned MK-VII unit has surfaced on the black market, still containing the encrypted memories and tactical files of its deceased operator — a high-ranking commander whose death was officially ruled an accident but whose final data logs suggest otherwise

A player character is offered a MK-VII installation in exchange for a single mission deep in contested territory — but the Arcturus technician performing the surgery has her own agenda buried in the firmware update she's loading

The Warlord Circle's private quantum channel has begun broadcasting a distress signal that no living MK-VII operator claims to be sending, originating from coordinates inside a city that was supposedly depopulated three years ago
